He is a classmate of [[Chloe]]'s in the [[Vermilion City school]]. ==History== Yeardley first appeared in ''[[JN011|Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!]]'', where he answered a question asked by his homeroom teacher. In ''[[JN029|There's a New Kid in Town!]]'', he was present in Chloe's class. Another schoolmate asked Yeardley to catch Pokémon after class. Yeardley appeared briefly in ''[[JN087|Breaking the Ice!]]'', welcoming [[Regina]]. However, when he and other students crowded close to Regina, her {{p|Glaceon}} attacked the students thinking they were bullying her. When Regina reconciled with the class, Yeardley joined the other students to play in the park made of ice by {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and Regina's Pokémon. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color light}}|bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |en=[[Melissa Schoenberg]] |fr_eu=Julie Basecqz |he=דור סרוגו ''Dor Srugo'' ([[JN087]]) |pt_br=João Pedro Teixeira |pl=Tymon Krylik ([[JN011]])
